ui.list.sub_global: Gestures that work in every app.
ui.list.sub_app: Apply only in {where}, and take priority over global gestures.
ui.list.disable_tip: Mouse buttons pass through to {where} as-is: no trail, no screen edges
ui.list.turn_off_gestures: Turn off gestures in this app
ui.list.off_banner: Gestures are turned off in **{where}**: right, middle and side buttons all pass through to it, and screen edges won’t trigger. The gestures below are kept and will work again once you turn them back on.
ui.list.empty_edges_hint: Push the mouse into a corner or against an edge of the screen to trigger — for example, the bottom-left corner opens the Start menu, and scrolling on the top edge adjusts the volume.
ui.list.empty_gestures_hint: Create one, or import existing gestures under “Import & export”.
ui.list.empty_app_hint: Gestures added here override global gestures with the same drawing.
ui.list.dup_tip: Another gesture in this scope has exactly the same drawing
ui.editor.conflict: Exactly the same drawing as {names}; only the last one takes effect
ui.editor.execute_now_help: No need to release the mouse button. Good for gestures that trigger repeatedly, like adjusting volume with the wheel.
ui.editor.hide_label: Don’t show the gesture name while drawing
ui.pattern.edge_help: Push the mouse to this spot on the screen to trigger. With no further steps, it runs as soon as you arrive.
ui.shape.instruction: Draw the same shape 2–3 times as you normally would. Release the mouse button to add each sample.
ui.shape.limit: Full — remove a sample to draw again
ui.shape.needs_sample: Draw at least one valid sample to save your changes.
ui.shape.differ: These samples differ quite a bit. Try keeping the same starting point and drawing direction.
ui.shape.conflict: This shape is very similar to the gesture “{name}” and may be hard to distinguish.
ui.shape.release: Shape gestures run when you release the mouse button.
ui.shape.too_short: The drawing is too short or has no stroke. Try drawing it bigger.
ui.recorder.use_line_drop_samples: Use last drawing as a line (remove shape samples)
ui.recorder.complex_hint: Complex curves work better as shapes.
ui.shape.more_samples: Add 1–2 more samples as you normally draw, keeping the same starting point and direction.
ui.recorder.too_short: Too short — draw a bigger stroke
ui.recorder.hint: Hold a mouse button and draw the gesture here
ui.action.activate_first: Activate the window under the cursor before sending
ui.action.window_op_help: Applies to the window under the cursor when the gesture started.
ui.action.url_help: If the selected text is already a URL, it opens directly.
ui.action.browser_ph: Leave empty for the default browser
ui.action.shell_help: Runs in a hidden cmd window.
ui.action.lua_help: Entry point ms_action(); ms.keys, ms.show_toast, ms.run and more are available. Scripts from the legacy format (WG.*) also run as-is.
ui.prefs.title: Preferences
ui.prefs.autostart_help: Requires mousetroke.exe in the same folder as this app
ui.prefs.show_tray: Show an icon in the notification area
ui.prefs.pause_hotkey_help: Temporarily turn gestures off for fullscreen games or presentations.
ui.prefs.drag_timeout: Hold-still time before treating it as a click
ui.prefs.drag_timeout_help: If the mouse button is held without moving for this long, it counts as a normal right-click / drag.
ui.prefs.stroke_px_help: How many pixels of movement count as a drawn stroke. Lower is more sensitive, but also more likely to misfire.
ui.prefs.show_label: Show the gesture name while drawing
ui.picker.title: Choose an app
ui.picker.suggest_hint: These apps use right/middle-button dragging themselves
ui.picker.disable_all_installed: Turn off gestures in all {count} installed
ui.picker.not_installed: Not detected — you can still add it
ui.picker.no_match: No matching app. Use “Browse” below to pick an exe file.
ui.picker.added_switch_off: Added — pick again to turn gestures off
ui.picker.drop_hint: You can also drop an app or its shortcut into this window
ui.picker.pick_tip: Click an app window on screen to add it (Esc cancels)
ui.data.title: Import & export
ui.data.legacy_help: Choose gestures.json; if prefs.json sits in the same folder, trail colors, the pause hotkey and other preferences are imported together.
ui.data.undo_help: Both can be undone with Ctrl+Z.
ui.guide.p1_title: Hold the right button, draw a stroke
ui.guide.p1_body: Hold the right mouse button in any window and drag out a shape; release to run it. For example, draw **←** to go back, **↓→** to close a tab. A plain right-click still opens the menu as usual.
ui.guide.p2_body: No buttons needed: push the mouse into the **bottom-left corner** to open the Start menu, the **bottom-right corner** to show the desktop; scroll while touching the **top edge** to change the volume. These live under “Screen edges”.
ui.guide.p3_title: Don’t want gestures in some app?
ui.guide.p3_body_installed: Remote desktop, 3D and design apps need the right or middle button for dragging. These were found on this PC — the checked ones will have gestures turned off:
ui.guide.p3_body_none: Remote desktop, 3D and design apps often use right- or middle-button dragging. Pick “Turn off gestures in it” in “Add app…” and click the app’s window; fullscreen games pause gestures automatically.
ui.guide.p4_body: The icon in the bottom-right of the taskbar: left-click opens settings, right-click pauses gestures or quits. You can also use a hotkey to pause / resume:
ui.guide.p4_note: Gestures pause automatically in fullscreen games, videos and presentations.

ui.about.star_prompt: Mousetroke is free and open source. If it helps you, a star on GitHub costs nothing and helps more people find it.
ui.about.log_help: When gestures don’t fire or clicks misbehave, the log records how each input was judged.
ui.about.kbd_toggle: Turn the selected gesture on / off

cli.help:
Mousetroke {version} — global mouse gestures for Windows

Usage:
  mousetroke import <gestures.json> [prefs.json] [-o <output>]
  mousetroke [run] [--config <path>]          start the gesture engine (hot-reloads config changes)
  mousetroke autostart on|off|status
  mousetroke settings [config path]            open the settings UI
  mousetroke lua <script.lua>                  run a Lua gesture script directly
  mousetroke diag                              diagnostics: other mouse tools, target under cursor, fullscreen
cli.run.load_failed:
{err}
Tip: run `mousetroke import <gestures.json>` first to create a config
